name: Young Adults
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of young adults living in obedience to God's Word, as seen in Psalms 119:9 where cleansing one's way is linked to heeding God's commandments. Proverbs encourages the remembrance and keeping of God's law from youth (Proverbs 3:1) and highlights the strength and glory inherent in young men (Proverbs 20:29). Ecclesiastes balances the call to rejoice in youth with a sober reminder that God will bring judgment for all actions (Ecclesiastes 11:9), urging young people to remember their Creator before the challenges of life come (Ecclesiastes 12:1). Furthermore, Proverbs 22:6 underscores the lasting impact of early training in God's ways, promising that such instruction leads to steadfastness in later life.
